legal.termsBody:
## What the service does

Derech Kohanim computes driving routes that avoid the zones marked forbidden for kohanim at the stringency level you choose. Every route is verified on the server against the polygons before it is shown.

## What the service does not promise

Avoidance quality depends on the quality of the zone data and of the routing provider road data. A route marked unverified must not be relied on and must not start live navigation. Final halachic responsibility rests with the user.

## Privacy

Origin and destination are sent to the routing provider to compute the route. Address search queries are cached on the server for a limited period to reduce calls. The privacy policy has the full detail.

## Driving safety

Do not operate the interface while driving. Voice guidance is the primary channel, the screen is a backup.
legal.privacyBody:
## What this document covers

This policy applies to the Derech Kohanim website, the app and the server behind them. It explains what is collected, what for, who it is shared with, how long it is kept and how to ask for it to be deleted.

## Using the service without an account

The service works as a guest, with no registration. A guest gets full navigation, and their preferences stay on the device.

## What is collected

**Account data, only if you register.** Email address and display name. A password is stored only as a one-way hash, never as readable text. Signing in with Google also stores the Google account identifier and the profile picture. The accepted terms version and the time it was accepted are stored too.

**Preferences.** Language, theme, stringency level, live traffic, avoiding toll roads, avoiding danger zones and the voice settings. For a guest these stay on the device; with an account they sync across devices.

**Places.** Saved places, including home and work, and the recent destinations history. Stored on the server only for an account holder.

**Route and navigation data.** The origin, the destination and the computation preferences are sent to the server to compute a route. The computed route is stored so live navigation, rerouting and a check that the avoidance actually worked are possible. During live navigation the current position is sent to the server to update progress, detect going off route and warn before a zone.

**Reports and feedback.** A road report is stored with its type and location. End-of-trip feedback is stored with the rating and the free text, if any was written.

**Usage data.** If measurement is enabled, anonymous screen-level data is collected: the page path and operational events. It carries no addresses, coordinates or user identifiers.

## Why the data is collected

- To compute a route and navigate it, which is the service itself.
- To verify that a route really avoids the zones, and to investigate avoidance failures.
- To keep preferences and places, and sync them across devices.
- To improve the service from aggregate usage.

The data is not sold, not rented and not passed to advertisers.

## Who the data is shared with

- **The routing provider** receives the origin, destination and computation preferences in order to return a route.
- **The maps and search provider** receives the search query in order to return address suggestions, and serves the map tiles.
- **Google**, when signing in with a Google account, verifies the identity and returns the address, name and picture.
- **A measurement service**, if enabled, receives the anonymous usage data.

Beyond that, data is disclosed only where the law requires it.

## What is stored on the device

Browser storage holds the session tokens, the language, the preferences, the terms acceptance and an offline cache of the last route and its voice clips. Clearing browser data or removing the app deletes them.

## How long data is kept

- Stored routes, navigation sessions and performance data are deleted automatically after 30 days.
- The address search cache is kept for a limited period and refreshed.
- Account data, preferences and saved places are kept as long as the account exists.
- Trip feedback outlives the route it was left on; once that route is deleted the feedback is no longer linked to it.

## Permissions the service asks for

- **Location**, to show your position and to navigate. You may refuse, and then type a starting point instead.
- **Speaker**, to play the voice guidance.

Every permission can be revoked at any time from the browser or operating system settings.

## Security

Traffic is encrypted. Passwords are stored hashed, and refresh tokens are stored hashed and can be revoked, so a copy of the database does not hand out access to accounts.

## Your rights

- To see the data held about you and ask for it to be corrected.
- To change or remove saved places and history from within the app itself.
- To ask for your account and all of its data to be deleted. The request is made from a dedicated page, and can be made after the app has been removed.

## Changes to this policy

This document is updated when the way data is handled changes, along with the update date at the top of the page.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account and data
deleteAccount.intro: Ask here for your account and everything stored with it to be deleted. The request can be made after the app has already been removed from your device.
deleteAccount.signedInAs: Signed in as {{email}}. The request will be recorded against this account.
deleteAccount.guestNote: Not signed in. Enter the address you registered with, and we will verify it with you before deleting anything.
deleteAccount.emailHint: The address you sign in with

whatHappens.recorded: The request is recorded and reaches the operations team.
whatHappens.verified: A request sent from a signed-in session is verified automatically. An anonymous request is verified against the address before anything is touched.
whatHappens.removed: On deletion the account, preferences, saved places and history are removed. Navigation and route data is disowned, and is deleted anyway within 30 days.
whatHappens.irreversible: Deletion cannot be undone. Saved places cannot be recovered afterwards.
